title: Northgate Optical Service Features by Lens Design
content:
Northgate Optical service features are the same on all six lens designs.

| Feature | Northgate Single Vision Lenses | Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses | Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Charge components that can earn Annual Reward | frame, base lenses, anti-reflective coating, light-adaptive, blue-light filter, material upgrade | same | same | same | same | same |
| Frame adjustments and nose pad replacements free for the life of the eyewear | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Eyewear may be ordered for household dependents under the membership | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Lenses fitted into a frame the member brings in | no | no | no | no | no | no |

## Reading the chart

- **Annual Reward components.** Six charge components can earn Annual Reward: the frame, the base lenses, the anti-reflective coating, the light-adaptive option, the blue-light filtering option and the material upgrade. A remake charge is not among them.
- **Adjustments.** Frame adjustments and nose pad replacements are free for as long as the eyewear lasts.
- **Household dependents.** The member may order eyewear for household dependents under the membership.
- **Own frames.** No design is fitted into a frame the member brings in; lenses go only into frames sold by Northgate.
